def: to exist before, i.e. (adverbially) to be or do something previously

occurrences.text: And the same day Pilate and Herod were made friends together: for before they were at enmity between themselves.
But there was a certain man, called Simon, which beforetime in the same city used sorcery, and bewitched the people of Samaria, giving out that himself was some great one:

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
